action_description: powerful heavy throw: big wind-up, he leans far back and pulls the glowing golden fish-skeleton shuriken behind his head, then whips his whole body forward and hurls it hard with his arm fully extended, his body lunges forward with the force of the throw and his scarf snaps forward, a short recoil, then back to his smug standing pose; keep the same south-east diagonal facing in every frame, do not turn toward the camera
